blocks.text: Background. Why the current path is the wrong tool

Ben Crowe owns a leftover that is easy to skip: rf.pinecrest.internal. I will ping once. After that the owner is late, not blocked. Unique to this file (27): refuse on neatness as the QA score, lock is 1 in 20, SKU/qty/lot, sheet, neatness out. I will not hide a process change inside a 'quick align' on PCF-2466.
If QA is a vibe, we will pass pretty totes and fail ugly right ones.

What a skeptical lead would try first on pack.pinecrest.internal: the path Tasha Quinn actually has, not an empty-tote photo. Metric I will argue is a clean confirm, not a vanity units-per-hour. If we cannot show that path on wms.pinecrest.internal with the numbers already in this file, we do not have a cut. Jeilen Jones will not accept a hallway yes as that proof.
